query.text: 请帮我留意老人服药的准备情况，他看过药和水后仍没有开始服药时，请告诉我。
query.text_en: Please watch the older person preparing to take medication and tell me if he looks at the medicine and water but does not begin taking it.

annotation.text_zh: 老人看过茶几上的药和水后，还没有开始服药，请确认是否需要提醒。
annotation.text_en: After looking at the medicine and water on the coffee table, he has not started taking the medicine. Please check whether a reminder is needed.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
